services.name: Prenatal at Postnatal Care
services.description: Regular check‑ups, iron/folic acid supplementation, at counseling para sa mga buntis.

services.name: Birthing / Maternity Services
services.description: Normal Spontaneous Delivery (NSD) para sa low‑risk pregnancies at newborn care.

services.name: Immunization Services
services.description: Routine at catch‑up vaccines para sa mga sanggol at bata: BCG, DPT, Polio, Hep B, MMR.

services.name: Under‑five Clinics
services.description: Pagsubaybay sa paglaki at nutrisyon ng mga bata, kasama ang Operation Timbang.

services.name: Newborn Screening & Hearing Tests
services.description: Maagang pagtuklas ng mga congenital conditions.

services.name: Family Planning Counseling
services.description: Counseling sa natural at artificial na pamamaraan.

services.name: Contraceptive Distribution
services.description: Pagbibigay ng pills, condoms, injectables, at IUD insertion.

services.name: Pre‑marriage Counseling
services.description: Mandatory counseling para sa mga aplikante ng marriage license.

services.name: Routine Lab Tests
services.description: Complete Blood Count (CBC), urinalysis, fecalysis, at pregnancy tests.

services.name: Specialized Screening
services.description: Blood typing, sputum smear microscopy (para sa TB), malaria testing, at HIV/STI screening.

services.name: Blood Chemistry
services.description: Fasting blood sugar (FBS), cholesterol, at creatinine tests.

services.name: National Tuberculosis Control Program (TB‑DOTS)
services.description: Identification, diagnosis, at directly observed treatment.

services.name: Lifestyle Diseases
services.description: Screening at management ng Hypertension (HPN) at Diabetes Mellitus (DM).

services.name: Rabies Prevention & Control
services.description: Anti‑rabies vaccines (sa ilalim ng rabies control program).

services.name: Food & Water Safety
services.description: Inspeksyon ng food establishments, water supply testing, at pag‑iisyu ng sanitary permits.

services.name: Dental Services
services.description: Dental consultation, oral health education, tooth extraction, filling, at gum treatment.

services.name: Minor Surgical Cases
services.description: Circumcision ("Operation Tuli"), suturing ng superficial lacerations, excision ng small cysts.

services.name: Pharmacy Services (Medisina para sa Bayan)
services.description: Libreng gamot para sa mga karaniwang karamdaman.

services.name: Medical Certifications
services.description: Pag‑iisyu ng sertipiko para sa employment, school admission, o PWD/senior citizen benefits.

services.name: Mental Health Services
services.description: Consultations at mental health education.

services.name: Medical Outreach Services
services.description: Mobile clinics at medical missions sa mga barangay.
